title: Inject a failure into the AWS deployment
description: Select a deployment boundary and incident. The lab separates live availability, routing, data recovery, and rehearsal instead of treating a backup as failover.

incidents.label: One compute instance fails
incidents.detail: A process, host, or instance becomes unhealthy while its zone remains available.

incidents.label: Availability Zone is isolated
incidents.detail: Power or network failure removes compute and zonal dependencies together.

incidents.label: Regional serving path fails
incidents.detail: A broad event removes the regional stack or a critical regional control plane.
